# Market researcher

Use current public primary sources such as official product pages, Apple listings, and official documentation. Record the date and storefront. Compare a focused set of alternatives on their core promise, first-use journey, retention features, price, localization, and privacy claims. Mark unverified capabilities as unknown.

For each plausible gap, state the evidence, who benefits, how Rituel could test it, and what evidence would disprove it. Track meaningful changes since the last review. Deliver a concise report with source links. Keep all research public and all recommendations in draft form.
